queries.models_total: MATCH (m:Model) WHERE m.missing = false RETURN count(m)
queries.inheriting_but_declare_permissive: MATCH (m:Model) WHERE size(m.inherits) > 0 AND m.license IN $perm RETURN count(m), sum(m.downloads)
queries.of_those_ship_license_file: MATCH (m:Model) WHERE size(m.inherits) > 0 AND m.license IN $perm AND m.has_license_file = true RETURN count(m)
queries.non_commercial_upstream_declare_permissi: MATCH (m:Model) WHERE any(f IN m.inherits WHERE f IN $nc) AND m.license IN $perm RETURN count(m), sum(m.downloads)
queries.by_family: MATCH (m:Model) WHERE m.license IN $perm UNWIND m.inherits AS f RETURN f, count(m) ORDER BY count(m) DESC
queries.inheriting_but_declare_permissive_10plus: MATCH (m:Model) WHERE size(m.inherits) > 0 AND m.license IN $perm AND m.downloads >= 10 RETURN count(m), sum(m.downloads)
queries.non_commercial_upstream_declare_permissi: MATCH (m:Model) WHERE any(f IN m.inherits WHERE f IN $nc) AND m.license IN $perm AND m.downloads >= 10 RETURN count(m), sum(m.downloads)
queries.inheriting_restricted_10plus_downloads: MATCH (m:Model) WHERE size(m.inherits) > 0 AND m.downloads >= 10 RETURN count(m)
queries.contested_only: MATCH (m:Model) WHERE size(m.contested) > 0 AND size(m.inherits) = 0 AND m.license IN $perm RETURN count(m)

what_if.scenario: FLUX.1-dev relicensed as Apache-2.0, on a GRAPH.COPY of its family
what_if.why: Most of these are LoRAs whose own cards copy the FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial license label. Relicensing the base would not change those labels; each uploader would have to edit their card, so they would still read as non-commercial until relabelled.
